water_levels.scope: Regional river level context. Lago Grande de Curuai has a separate lake water level and responds to river flow through a connected floodplain.

evidence.title: HYBAM · Curuai floodplain and the Amazon River
evidence.notes: The field study describes seasonal storage and release between the Curuai floodplain and the Amazon River. Local lake stage depends on channels, rainfall and other conditions as well as main-stem water levels.
